summary.headline: Fredun Pharma Q1 FY27 standalone total income rose 90.44% YoY to INR228.25 crores; EBITDA INR32.78 crores, margin 14.36%.
summary.overview: Standalone total income for Q1 FY27 was INR228.25 crores, up 90.44% YoY, with EBITDA of INR32.78 crores (up 92.90%) and EBITDA margin of 14.36% (up 18 bps). Net profit was INR13.17 crores (up 94.63%), with net margin at 5.77% (up 12 bps). Management attributed the strong Q1 partly to orders booked at old prices in the prior quarter and higher stock carried into Q4 FY26. Management reiterated FY27 revenue target of around INR800 crores and said it is on track to overachieve, declining to commit to INR1,000 crores.

segments.name: New-age brands
segments.commentary: Growing ~35-45% YoY per management, with some growing faster off lower bases; vintage business growing ~15-20% YoY.

segments.name: Fredun GX (generics)
segments.commentary: Present in ~19 states (vs 17 cited in question), revenue base ~INR100-110 crores; management guides 25-35% growth, and 30-35% for the next four years.

segments.name: Pet care (incl. functional foods)
segments.commentary: Current pet care business ~INR40-45 crores; functional foods FY27 target INR18-24 crores; guided 40-50% growth over next 3-4 years. Cat food launch planned around Q4 FY27, with a target of INR100 crores within 3-3.5 years of launch.

segments.name: Wagr.in (pet e-commerce)
segments.commentary: Soft launch around 15 June 2026 in beta; ~1,500-2,000 products listed; management expects brand onboarding complete within 20-25 days and beta testing done in 60-65 days. Described as a separate company within the Fredun ecosystem.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target around INR800 crores; management says it is in line to achieve and hopes to cross it, but declined to commit to INR1,000 crores.
Blended growth of ~30-35% over next 3 years expected by management, combining new-age brands, vintage business and new capacity.
Growth in coming quarters expected to be around the same level as Q1 FY27, per management.

Management expects margin improvement and a profitability step-up in roughly 7-11 quarters as demographic reach completes; it expects EBIT margin to be near 12-13% within about 12 quarters, with timing uncertainty of a quarter either way.
Working capital absolute value will rise with revenue (e.g., at INR2,000-3,000 crores revenue), but management sees it in line with manufacturing peers.
capex_capacity: CapEx plan of INR30-40 crores in FY27, with a similar INR30-40 crores next year; INR35-45 crores per year for the next two years per management.
Maintenance capex estimated at about 2% of revenue at ~INR1,000 crores revenue level.
Goal by end-December 2028 / early 2029 to be among the largest manufacturing units at a single location in India.
Five plants in Palghar; management cites ~43 locations where products are manufactured.
Functional food capacity build-out underway; OEM supply planned for other companies.
demand_pricing: Management attributed part of Q1 strength to orders booked at old prices in Q4 FY26 ahead of price increases, and to higher stock held in the prior quarter.
Q1 is seasonally weaker as sales targets drive purchases in Q4; orders typically start rolling in around end-April.
Pharmacies and distributors are said to be willing to hold more inventory of Fredun products; GX repeatability described as high.
Functional foods: Jain variant picked up well in certain pockets; 42 functional food variants being added; cat biscuit treats planned.
Gross margin ranges cited: pet care 45-55%, mobility 40-50%, nutrition 35-50%, dermaceutics 70-75%. Management said it may sacrifice some margin to drive penetration.

qa_highlights.question: Where can Fredun be in 3-5 years, given FY27 Q1 revenue nearly matches FY23 full-year revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Blended growth of ~30-35% for next 3 years from new-age brands (35-45%), vintage (15-20%), new capacity, and 43 manufacturing locations.

qa_highlights.question: How large can domestic GX become over 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: GX is in ~19 states with a base of ~INR100-110 crores; guided 25-35% growth, and 30-35% over the next four years.

qa_highlights.question: Can you guide CapEx for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: INR30-40 crores in FY27 and similar next year; INR35-45 crores per year for two years; maintenance about 2% of revenue at ~INR1,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Q1 so strong and will future quarters keep this growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Partly due to old-price bookings and higher stock in Q4 FY26; future quarters expected to grow at roughly Q1's rate.

qa_highlights.question: Working capital outlook and interest cost trend?
qa_highlights.answer: Working capital at ~INR170-175 crores on ~INR850 crores run rate, rising with scale; interest cost falling as limit usage declines; rating upgraded from BBB to BBB+.

qa_highlights.question: Inventory days target?
qa_highlights.answer: Currently ~135-140 days, targeted at ~120 days within four quarters, with a 110-125 day range expected long term.

qa_highlights.question: Will revenue hit INR1,000 crores and EBIT INR100 crores this year, and will EBIT margin reach 12-13%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to commit; FY27 target ~INR800 crores, on track to overachieve. EBIT margin near 12-13% expected in roughly 12 quarters, with timing uncertain.

risks_watch: Q1 strength partly reflects pre-buying at old prices and higher stock in Q4 FY26, so the YoY comparison may not persist.
Management said it may trade margins for penetration in the near term.
Working capital will rise in absolute terms with growth; inventory days still ~135-140 days versus a 120-day target.
Wagr e-commerce and planned acquisitions (details not yet given) are unquantified; cat food and diagnostics revenue timing still to be confirmed.
Management guidance has been qualitative on EBIT margin timing, which relies on demographic reach completion.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on long-term growth, but deliberately non-committal on near-term numeric targets (declined INR1,000 crore revenue and quantified EBIT timing). Cautious on margins, citing penetration-first strategy.
key_quotes: We are not in the dumping game.
Inventory days have gone down by almost 50% in the last 2 years.
we are consistently showing growth not for the last 3 years, 4 years, but for the last 19 years.

adds.what: Functional food capacity build-out (no quantified capacity given)

growth.why: Management reiterates FY27 revenue target of ~INR800 crores (implying roughly 26% over FY26's INR635 crores) and guides 30-35% blended growth over 3 years, backed by segment growth guides and a planned INR30-40 crore capex, but no specific new capacity with numbers or timing was given, and Q1's 90% jump was partly pulled forward by pre-price-hike orders.
